entities.name: otel-demo/Service/flagd
entities.reasoning: Flagd returned error status in many spans, causing downstream services to fail.
entities.evidence: Trace metrics show STATUS_CODE_ERROR for flagd.evaluation spans from cart and recommendation services.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/cart
entities.reasoning: Cart service observed flagd errors and emitted its own errors.
entities.evidence: Trace spans for cart contain STATUS_CODE_ERROR on ResolveBoolean and POST /CartService calls.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/recommendation
entities.reasoning: Recommendation service also suffered flagd errors, raising its error rate.
entities.evidence: Trace metrics for recommendation show STATUS_CODE_ERROR on flagd evaluation spans.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/checkout
entities.reasoning: Checkout depended on cart and recommendation; their failures propagated.
entities.evidence: Trace paths include checkout→cart and checkout→recommendation with error spans.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/frontend
entities.reasoning: Frontend returned 5xx errors due to downstream checkout failures.
entities.evidence: RequestErrorRate and RequestLatency alerts fired around 17:59 for frontend service.

propagations.condition: Flagd ResolveBoolean calls returned error status

propagations.effect: Frontend observed high error rate and latency
